items.description: S0-VTOL with autonomous ship launch/landing capability, ~15,000 ft ceiling, 1+ km vertical sounding payload

notes: NOAA Ron Brown vessel deployment for S0-VTOL with autonomous ship launch/recovery and atmospheric sounding. Spring 2028 target. Chidong Zhang actively evaluating lease vs. purchase; detailed RFQ sent 2026-10-06 with 18 technical questions. BST acknowledged production delays; current estimate mid-to-late 2027 availability. May include multiple aircraft (4 operational + 4 spare lease scenario discussed). Requires training, remote support, and publication collaboration. Active engagement as of 2026-11-03. Recent email traffic (2026-11-03) confirms ongoing quote refinement for lease/purchase options.
